agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and ratified the financial statements audited by Purwanto Susanti and Surja, granting full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved distributing USD 123,900,000 as cash dividends, representing 90% of net profit, and allocating USD 13,796,649 to mandatory reserves.
Agenda #3: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine the 2026 remuneration and 2025 performance bonuses for the Board and Directors, subject to approval from PT Pertamina Power Indonesia.
Agenda #4: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a Public Accounting Firm for the 2026 audit and determine associated fees.
Agenda #5: The company presented a report regarding the status of funds raised from the Initial Public Offering as of December 31, 2025, which required no formal decision.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved adjusting the timeline for utilizing IPO funds through 2030 for business development and digital CAPEX, while confirming 15% of proceeds for debt repayment. Authority was granted to manage project funding through subsidiaries or consortiums for various geothermal working areas.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved delegating authority to the Board of Commissioners for 12 months to implement the Management and Employee Stock Option Program (MESOP). This authorization includes the power to increase the company's paid-up capital and determine policies regarding share volume and exercise prices.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved adding new business activities in data processing, computing infrastructure, and mining equipment rental based on feasibility studies. It also authorized updating 19 KBLI codes to align with BPS Regulation Number 7 of 2025.
Agenda #9: Yurizki Rio was honorably discharged from his position, and Fransetya Hasudungan Hutabarat was appointed as the new Finance Director for the 2026-2029 term. The meeting also confirmed the full composition of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors.
